text: So, what should you do when a girl suddenly pulls away? She says, you know, we move too fast or everything annoys me lately. Or some other stuff along those lines. Here's what you don't do. You don't chase, you don't try to convince her, you don't show up like nothing happened. Here's what you do. You walk away. If someone doesn't want to spend time with you, you shouldn't want to spend time with them either. If you want, you can send a message like this. Hey, I've thought about it. Since you are clearly pulling away, I don't think meeting up makes sense anymore. But say it because you mean it not to play games and go through with it. When someone shows you they don't value what you give them, that's your sign to walk away and value yourself even more.
